title: Redux Store
description: Schema representing the Redux store configuration and state tree structure used in Redux applications.

state.description: The current immutable state tree of the application.

reducer.description: A pure function that takes the current state and an action as arguments and returns a new state result.

middleware.description: Array of middleware functions applied to the store for intercepting actions.

enhancers.description: Store enhancers that extend the store with additional capabilities.
